description: An intentConfig without mode. iOS reports it through embeddedPaymentElementLoadingFailed and resolves; Android's view manager throws while parsing the intentConfiguration prop.
skipTypecheck: IntentConfiguration.mode is required by the public types; this fixture omits it to pin how each platform fails.

android.thrown: PaymentSheetException: If `intentConfiguration` is provided, `intentConfiguration.mode` is required

parityGaps.result: G10: iOS resolves after reporting the failure; Android has no promise on this path.
parityGaps.events.loadingFailed.message: G10: iOS reports the failure as an event; Android throws instead.
parityGaps.thrown: G10: Android's parseIntentConfiguration rethrows the PaymentSheetException from the prop setter.
